title: Searching Your Photos
drDigitalIntro:
Photo apps can recognize what is in your pictures.
• Search 'beach' to see all your beach photos.
• Search 'dog', or type someone's name.
• It saves huge time, and the search happens right on your device.

steps.say: Click the search icon to open the search bar.

drDigitalSuccess: You searched your photos! The photo app finds images by what is in them so you can search by name, place, or subject.
drDigitalHint: Click the search icon in the sidebar, then type a word like 'beach' to find matching photos.
